room.prompt: A clean wafer workshop in cool silver-grey daylight: a wire saw on the left, a polishing pad in the middle, a clear wafer carrier with slots on the right, all seen low from the bench.

stage.where: standing on the bench in the front middle
stage.near: the carrier's slots and the pad are drawn to its size

saw.prompt: A wire saw in a cool pearl and steel-blue workshop: a long silver ingot lying supported in a cradle across the picture, a frame of fine glinting wires cutting through it into thin discs, the discs separating at the right end

stage.where: at the right end where the discs separate
stage.near: each disc is its own size

edge.prompt: A close view of an edge grinder in steel-blue light: a soft spinning wheel touching the rim of a thin round disc held on a small chuck

stage.where: on the chuck in the middle
stage.near: the wheel is about its own size

polish.prompt: A close view of a soft round polishing pad in pearl light, one broad soft reflection across it

stage.where: on the pad in the middle
stage.near: the pad is wider than it

clean.prompt: A close view of a rinse station: a gentle sheet of clean water falling over a small stand, pearl light

stage.where: on the stand in the middle
stage.near: the stand is its own size

carrier.prompt: A loading station in pearl and steel-blue light: an open clear wafer carrier with slots on the right, thin shiny discs standing in most of them, one slot empty at the front

stage.where: just in front of the empty slot
stage.near: each slot is its own size

carrier2.prompt: the carrier's clear lid is now closed

W_cut.pose: a thin round disc just separated, standing, surprised, looking at its own thinness

W_spin.pose: standing on its edge, held steady, eyes squeezed, a little dizzy

W_shine.pose: facing us, its surface mirror-bright with one broad soft reflection, delighted

W_rinse.pose: eyes closed, water running off it, shaking off drops, pleased

W_admire.pose: turning to inspect its own new smooth edge, pleased, one hand on its rim

W_ask.pose: standing in front of a slot, hopeful brows raised, hands together, asking

W_nod.pose: a small understanding nod, a warm smile
